address.label: Al Mannan Residency, Red Hills, Hyderabad
address.formal_address: 11-5-185, Flat 102, Behind Masjid e Teen Posh, Red Hills, Nampally, Hyderabad - 500004

distinguishing_features: Corner building at a right turn at the dead end of the street

approach_from.instructions: Enter the street opposite the complex with SBI and ICICI ATMs. Continue to the dead end — the building is on the corner where the street turns right.

approach_from.direction_label: Coming via road opposite Himalaya Hotel / Masjid Darul Irfan Road
approach_from.instructions: Look for Red Hills Diagnostic Lab. If it is on your right, cross it and take an immediate left. The building is the last one on that street, at the dead-end corner on the left.

entrance_details.identifying_marks: 'Al Mannan Residency' written in large blue-painted font beside the black gate
entrance_details.access_notes: No security guard on site — driver enters directly through the black gate

units.in_building_directions: Take the lift to the first floor. It is the 2nd door on the left.

trigger_conditions: Driver still can't locate the building after being guided through both approach directions
Driver reports Masjid e Teen Posh or Red Hills Diagnostic Lab is no longer recognizable/visible
